info.title: Prisma Reviews API
info.summary: One REST API to read and reply to reviews on the App Store, Google Play, Yelp, Tripadvisor and more.
info.description:
Read the reviews of the businesses and apps you own or manage on the App Store, Google Play, Judge.me, Trusted Shops, eKomi, Yelp, Tripadvisor, Booking.com, G2 and 20+ more platforms, all in one normalized JSON shape, and reply through each platform's official API where it has one (read-only platforms return the link where a review is answered). Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, eBay and Etsy are coming soon: `GET /v1/platforms` says which platforms are ready (`live_ready`).

- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Live keys (`pk_live_…`) work with real accounts; test keys (`pk_test_…`) connect any platform with sample locations and reviews and never publish replies. Test and live data never mix.
- **Format:** JSON in and out; timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; IDs are prefixed (`rev_`, `loc_`, `con_`, `we_`, `evt_`, `req_`).
- **Pagination:** `GET /v1/reviews` is cursor paginated (`data` + `next_cursor`).
- **Rate limits:** per key and per minute, set by the plan (Spark 60, Beam 120, Spectrum 600, Aurora 1,200), reported in `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.
- **Errors:** one shape, `{ "error": { "type", "code", "message", "retryable", "request_id", "docs_url" } }`; codes on https://prismareviews.com/docs/errors.
- **Webhooks:** signed `POST`s for new and updated reviews, published or failed replies and connection changes.

Get a free API key at https://app.prismareviews.com/signup.

get.description: Reviews of your workspace in the mode of your key, newest first (by `created_at`, then `id`), in the same shape on every platform. Cursor paginated: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor`, with the same filters, until it is `null`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only reviews written at or after this time (by `created_at`): a date (`2026-10-01`, midnight UTC) or an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone offset (`2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`, `2026-10-01T02:00:00+02:00`).

parameters.name: has_reply
parameters.description: `true`: reviews with a reply in any status. `false`: reviews without one.

post.description: Stores the reply and queues it for publishing through the platform's official API: `202` with the review and `reply.status: "queued"`. A background job publishes it (`reply.published` webhook) or marks it `failed` (`reply.failed` webhook). Posting again replaces the stored reply. With a test key the reply goes through the same steps but never reaches the platform. Read-only platforms return `422 reply_not_supported` with the review's `url`, where it can be answered.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value per reply (a UUID works). The same key with the same request returns the stored response instead of replying twice; with a different request it returns `409 idempotency_conflict`. Scoped to the workspace; only successful responses are stored.

text.description: Reply text, trimmed. 1 to 10,000 characters; the platform's own limit also applies (Google Business Profile 4,096 bytes, App Store 5,970 characters, Google Play 350, eBay 80).

example.text: Thanks Marta! We have added a second barista at lunch.

202.description: Reply queued. The body is the review with its new `reply`.

example.text: Great flat white, a bit slow at lunchtime.
example.author: Marta G.

reply.text: Thanks Marta! We have added a second barista at lunch.

error.message: No review with that id in this workspace.

409.description: The `Idempotency-Key` was used with a different request, or the connection of the review's location is not `active` (reconnect it, then retry).

error.message: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.
The connection for this location is not active. Reconnect it and try again.

422.description: `text` missing or empty, a body that isn't valid JSON (`invalid_request`), a read-only platform (`reply_not_supported`, with `platform` and `url`) or a text over the platform's limit (`reply_too_long`, with `platform` and `max_length`).

post.description: Checks one location for new reviews now instead of waiting for its next scheduled check ("Refresh now"). From the Beam plan; at most once every 15 minutes per location. New reviews arrive as usual, in `GET /v1/reviews` and as `review.created` webhooks.

202.description: Check queued. The body is the location plus `refresh: "queued"`.

403.description: The plan has no Refresh now (Spark, `feature: "refresh_now"`) or doesn't include the location's platform (`feature: "platform"`), both `plan_feature_unavailable` with `upgrade_url`; or the account is suspended (`account_suspended`).

error.message: Refresh now isn't included in the free Spark plan: it starts at Beam. Spark locations are checked on their regular schedule.

post.description: Connects one platform account and imports its locations. How depends on the platform (see `GET /v1/platforms`): `oauth` platforms need `redirect_url` and return `status: "pending"` with an `authorization_url` for the owner; `credentials` platforms need `credentials`, which Prisma tries against the platform before storing anything; `listing_url` platforms need the public `listing_url` of the listing. With a test key any platform connects at once, without credentials, with sample locations and reviews. Locations over the plan limit are not created and are counted in `locations_over_plan_limit`. Not idempotent: retrying creates a second connection.

test.summary: Any platform with a test key

201.description: The new connection, plus `authorization_url` (OAuth) or `locations_created` and `locations_over_plan_limit`.

403.description: The platform isn't in your plan (`plan_feature_unavailable`, with `platform`, `feature` and `upgrade_url`), isn't enabled for your account yet (`platform_not_enabled`), or the account is suspended (`account_suspended`).

error.message: Yelp isn't included in the free Spark plan: it starts at Beam, or add a read pack to Spark from the Plan page.

Errors about a known platform carry `required_fields`, `example` and `setup`.

delete.description: Disconnects the connection: its stored tokens and credentials are deleted at once and its locations become `disconnected` (no more checks, not counted toward the plan). Their reviews stay readable for 30 days and are then deleted. To reauthorize a connection, delete it and create a new one.

post.description: A link the owner of a platform account opens to connect it in their browser, with no Prisma account or API key. Connections made through it belong to your workspace and to the mode of the key that created the link, and carry `metadata: {"via": "connect_link"}`. Valid for 7 days and reusable: treat it like a password-reset link. The body is optional.

platform.description: Only this platform. Without it, the owner chooses among the platforms of your plan.

redirect_url.description: Where to send the owner when they are done, with `connection_id` and `status` added to the query string. Must start with `https://` (or `http://localhost` for development).

post.description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint for signed event deliveries. The signing `secret` is returned only in this response. Endpoints belong to the workspace, not to a key: they receive events from both live and test mode. Not idempotent: retrying creates a second endpoint.

events.description: Event types to receive, or `["*"]` for all of them (the default).

201.description: The endpoint, with its signing secret.

422.description: `url` missing, not a URL or not https, an unknown event type, an empty `events` array or a body that isn't valid JSON (`invalid_request`).

error.message: limit: Number must be less than or equal to 100

post.description: A new review was found on a connected location. Sent as a signed `POST` to every endpoint subscribed to `review.created` or `*`. Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds; failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff within your plan's retry window.

parameters.name: Prisma-Signature
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the endpoint secret>`. Reject timestamps more than 5 minutes off.

2XX.description: Received. Any other status, a timeout or a connection error is retried.

Reply.description: The business reply to a review.

created_at.description: When the reply was published. `null` while a first reply is queued; when a reply is replaced, it keeps the previous value until the new one is published.

status.description: `published` (live on the platform, whoever wrote it), `queued` (sent through Prisma, waiting to be published) or `failed` (the platform refused it; see `error`).

Review.description: One customer review, in the same shape on every platform.

location_id.description: The location the review belongs to (`loc_…`).

rating.description: 1 to 5 stars. `null` if the platform gave no rating.

title.description: Review title, on platforms that have one.

author.description: Display name as shown by the platform.

language.description: Language code when the platform provides one.

url.description: Public link to the review when the platform provides one. On read-only platforms, where to answer it.

created_at.description: When the review was written on the platform.

updated_at.description: When it was last edited on the platform.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor`, with the same filters, for the next page. `null` on the last page.

Location.description: One thing that receives reviews on one platform: a place, an app, a shop, a listing.

name.description: Name on the platform. For listing URL platforms, the listing URL.

address.description: Address for places. For App Store apps, the bundle ID.

url.description: Public page of the location, app or listing, when known.

last_synced_at.description: Last time Prisma checked it for reviews. `null` until the first sync finishes.

next_sync_at.description: When the next check is scheduled. `null` once disconnected.

Connection.description: The access a business gave Prisma to its account on one platform. Credentials and tokens are never returned.

status.description: `pending` (waiting for the owner to approve OAuth), `active`, `reauth_required` (the platform rejected the stored token or key) or `disconnected`.

metadata.description: Your own key-value pairs, returned as sent.

platform.description: Platform to connect. An unknown value returns `422 invalid_request`.

redirect_url.description: Required for `oauth` platforms (live keys): where the owner lands after approving, with `connection_id` and `status` in the query string.

credentials.description: Required for `credentials` platforms, and for Trustpilot (`domain`). Fields per platform in `GET /v1/platforms`.

listing_url.description: Required for `listing_url` platforms: the public page of the listing.

metadata.description: Your own key-value pairs, for example your client ID.

authorization_url.description: `oauth` platforms with a live key: send the account owner here to approve access.

locations_created.description: Locations imported (credentials, listing URL and test connections).

locations_over_plan_limit.description: Locations not imported because of the plan limit.

url.description: The link to send to the account owner.

platform.description: The only platform the link connects, or `null` for any of the plan.

mode.description: Mode of the connections it creates: that of the key.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working (7 days after creation).

name.description: Key inside `credentials`, or `listing_url` at the top level of the request.

file_accept.description: For textarea fields: the file the value usually comes from.

Platform.description: How a platform connects and whether this workspace can connect it now.

in_your_plan.description: Whether your plan (or its read packs) includes it.

available.description: Whether it is enabled for your account (some platforms open gradually).

live_ready.description: `false` while it can only be tried with test keys; a live `POST /v1/connections` returns `501 platform_not_available`.

live_note.description: Why it isn't ready for live keys yet.

summary.description: What the account owner needs before starting.

steps.description: Short setup steps for the account owner.

example.description: A request body for `POST /v1/connections` that works with a test key.

WebhookEventFilter.description: An event type, or `*` for all.

secret.description: Signing secret (`whsec_…`). Shown only in this response.

WebhookEvent.description: The body of a webhook delivery. Events carry IDs, not full objects; retries keep the same `id`.

used.description: Active live locations (test and disconnected ones are not counted).

limit.description: Locations of your plan plus the extra locations you pay for.

requests.description: API requests this month from all of the workspace's keys, test keys included. Requests over the rate limit are not counted.

replies_published.description: Replies published through Prisma this month.

used.description: Reads used this month by platforms read through paid data providers (Yelp, Tripadvisor, Booking.com…) on live connections.

limit.description: Reads included this month: the plan's plus read packs.

Error.description: Every error has this shape. Some codes add fields (for example `platform`, `url`, `max_length`, `connection_id`, `upgrade_url`, `required_fields`).

type.description: Family of the error, from the HTTP status.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code. Branch on this, not on `message`.

retryable.description: `true` for 429 and 5xx: the same request can succeed later.

request_id.description: The `req_…` ID, also in the `Request-Id` header.
